review:
Rusty & Curly is a goofy western on a 5x4 payline grid. Its Wild Posters arrive with hearts, a multiplier, or both. A poster stays and keeps awarding respins as long as it has at least one heart left, losing one heart per respin.

Multipliers on posters run from 2x upward, and the bonuses add multiplier wild reels. Unusually, Hacksaw says the 10,000x maximum is only reachable in the Stick to the Plan! and Who Shot the Sheriff? bonuses, not the base game. A lighthearted game with a clever take on sticky wilds.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
